title: Agent Review drop-off, scoped context access, and helper repair

source_statements.source_statement: Register this repair request as canonical source, link it to Issue #24, and avoid duplicate tasks or a second protocol.
Repair the Agent Review Hub dashboard so prompt cards show statuses, saved AGR results, repair links, and controls for copy/open/drop-off/block/view/rerun.
Copied prompts must include agent_review_run_id, prompt_key, return_url, dropoff_url, requirement_id, and idempotency_key.

Create an Agent-friendly drop-off form that accepts plain text or JSON reports, saves PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results, returns AGR IDs, links results, creates or links repair items for FAIL/BLOCKED, and generates rerun prompts.

Fix review-context access so unauthenticated hub/dropoff starts return to exact target after Operations login, show takeover-mode guidance, and blocked scoped contexts do not silently audit public helper.

Repair helper behavior so it never claims tickets/tasks/writes/actions executed without typed action/audit proof, routes private public-helper requests to safe login/support paths, avoids soliciting personal info publicly, and uses canonical resolver links.

Add required tests for redirect/returnTo, prompt metadata copy, plain-text and JSON drop-off, FAIL/BLOCKED repair/rerun, public helper private-data routing, false-success prevention, public-context prompt blocking, idempotency, secrets, and private-data safety.
App-visible work requires merge, deploy, live smoke, and final response in the requested 15-section format with one exact terminal verdict.
